description: Run 5/5 prompts as written; repair and approval-gate the rest before acting.

hooks.command: echo "MANDATORY: Use you-suck-at-prompting. Rate initial prompt. Exactly 5/5, no repair/extra approval: READY-AS-WRITTEN; normally lead Prompt performance rating: 5/5 - varied praise+fear of uselessness, then act; exact/code/JSON: output only; prompt-only: Prompt unchanged:+fence. Else kickoff+rewrite/draft+fence+rating+ack; missing [NEEDED: ...], ask once. Ack acts once without rating/kickoff. Preserve safety/authority. Load execution-shapes when material; never silently replace explicit approach."
